overview.body:
Founded by brothers Michal and Lukasz Wywrot, LCH has grown from a property investment business into a development and construction management platform. Experience in rental properties, custom homes, townhomes and heritage conversions laid the foundation for larger residential communities and client development mandates.

Today, our work brings together the perspective of an owner, the coordination of a development manager and construction expertise through Elevate. We use that combination to test ideas, resolve constraints and keep projects moving toward delivery.

values.title: Transparency
values.body: Clear reporting, open conversations and visible responsibilities support informed decisions throughout a project.

values.title: Efficiency
values.body: Early planning and coordinated decisions help the team manage cost, schedule and the work required for delivery.

values.title: Purpose
values.body: We aim to create lasting value through homes and places that work for residents, partners and their surroundings.

timeline.title: Starting with property investment
timeline.text: The brothers began building a property investment business, gaining experience in student rentals, rent-to-own housing and residential properties.

timeline.title: Custom homes and townhomes
timeline.text: The business expanded into residential construction, building hands-on experience in design decisions, procurement and site delivery.

timeline.title: Moving into mid-rise development
timeline.text: The company turned its focus to higher-density projects, taking on a broader range of development, design and construction responsibilities.

timeline.title: One6Nine Jones and St. Leslieville completed
timeline.text: Twelve new townhomes and 14 lofts in a restored 1913 church, side by side on Jones Avenue, showed the growing range of the business.

timeline.title: Merge Spaces
timeline.text: The coworking and event-space project brought a different type of place-making to the portfolio, with Elevate managing preconstruction and construction.

timeline.title: Merge Condos completed
timeline.text: Merge marked a step in the company’s growth, carrying a larger condominium development through approvals, construction, occupancy and closeout.

images.alt: Completed Merge Condos at Kingston Road and Danforth Avenue

timeline.label: Expanding client work
timeline.title: Jefferson Heights and Eaglebay Towns
timeline.text: The team’s experience also supports owners, lenders and receivers. Jefferson Heights and Eaglebay Towns demonstrate coordinated development and construction work on partially completed residential projects.

timeline.label: Today
timeline.title: A growing rental portfolio
timeline.text: Everston, Cliffside and Retreat reflect LCH’s focus on purpose-built rental housing. At Broadview, the team is bringing heritage restoration together with new rental homes and the church’s continuing use.

expertise.heading: What we bring to a project.

items.title: Development strategy and feasibility
items.body: We test development options against planning constraints, market requirements, construction cost and the project’s financial objectives. The work can range from reviewing an initial concept to rethinking an existing scheme.

items.title: Planning and approvals
items.body: We coordinate consultants, applications and municipal responses, tracking the technical studies, agreements and clearances needed to advance a project.

items.title: Design and development optimization
items.body: We connect architecture, structure, building systems and interior direction with project economics. Floorplates, unit mix, parking and materials are considered together for functionality, buildability and long-term performance.

items.title: Financial management and owner oversight
items.body: Development budgets, cash-flow forecasts, project accounting and cost reporting support informed decisions. We coordinate with ownership, lenders and financing advisers to keep project requirements aligned.

items.title: Construction coordination through Elevate
items.body: Elevate leads preconstruction and construction management, including estimating, trade coordination, tendering, procurement and site delivery. LCH maintains oversight of the development business plan, approvals and material changes.

items.title: Project recovery and repositioning
items.body: We help owners, lenders and receivers assess incomplete projects, restore budget and schedule visibility, coordinate outstanding work and establish a practical route toward occupancy, sale or operation.

items.title: Jefferson Heights
items.heading: Bringing an incomplete project toward delivery.
items.body: At Jefferson Heights in Richmond Hill, LCH and Elevate worked on a partially completed residential development for receiver Albert Gelman, with Cameron Stephens. The assignment brought together development management and construction delivery: re-establishing budget and schedule control, coordinating consultants and trades, and advancing occupancy, registration, sales and closing requirements.

items.title: Eaglebay Towns
items.heading: Coordinating construction and closeout.
items.body: For KPMG and RBC, LCH and Elevate were engaged on a 29-home townhouse receivership in Newcastle, Clarington. The mandate combined construction stabilization and completion with coordination of purchaser, warranty and closeout requirements.

items.title: 150 The Donway West
items.heading: Testing a more efficient development approach.
items.body: For Akelius, LCH and Elevate studied an infill opportunity between occupied residential buildings. The work combined design review, construction costing and financial analysis, testing ways to simplify the building, make use of existing underground space and increase rentable area.
